comparison.objective: Clean a fibre connector end face with a qualifying wipe and then insert it into an adapter; candidate breaks and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Contamination-safe wiping and connector insertion versus mandrel-to-insert coaxial alignment, bimanual hammering, load regulation, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: At least a 4 cm one-stroke wipe, no subsequent end-face contact, full insertion, and release; candidate requires four fractures, four deposited tangs, and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both involve precise alignment, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes—clean insertion versus controlled fracture and debris recovery—are materially different.
